title: Let render_report take the current time as a parameter
body: `render_report(title, rows)` in `reports/summary.py` calls `datetime.now()` itself, so its output cannot be tested. Please add an optional keyword argument `now` (a `datetime`). When it is given, the `Generated` line uses it; when it is omitted or `None`, the function uses the current time exactly as it does today. Nothing else about the output may change.
